training_import.scope: All original training research observations plus separate final confirmations. Only training; no development or audit. No GPU/model execution. Source file hashes recorded below.

dream_rsi.applied: Retain actually evaluated attempts; do not invent outcomes for unseen branches

known_limitations: Oversized or incomplete episodes rejected from this index; original failures and their costs must remain in external logs
Content hashes protect integrity, not authenticity against a privileged writer; callers must pin approved manifest IDs
Experimental experience input is up to32KiB and can increase model cost; no foreground production integration or automatic policy publication
Trace times are labeled as reported; API token usage is unknown in the archive and accounted separately
